gib_chippy.text: Fish and chips, Gibraltar-style. Same batter as Blackpool, but the fish has swum a bit further, and the vinegar has a lot more sun in it.
We get our fish from the Bay. Dentex, bream and a bit of squid. The chips are from a potato that has always been very British.

gib_chippy_cust.text: Fish and chips on Main Street, eaten with your back to the Rock, watching the Spanish ferry. It's my favourite thing in the world.
Mind the seagulls. They're half-Spanish and fully ruthless.
